description: feat(frontend): the character look survives a reload - every applied change is saved to localStorage, load() restores it, Export STL clears it
specRef: rwclab-structure.md «Board 8» (CharacterService, the Character tab) and «Board 8c»; README.md "The Character tab (board 8)"
notes:
WHY: the character lives only in CharacterService memory; F5 (or a crash) loses a long customisation, and S3 is wiped with the container so nothing server-side helps. The browser's localStorage is the durable place: write on every applied change, restore on the next load, clear once the result has been exported to disk (Export STL).
CONTRACT (binding for 8610 and 8630; the gate reads localStorage by this key and shape):
- localStorage key `rwclab.character.draft`, value = JSON of CharacterDraft { version: 1, look: CharacterLook, skin: 'photo' | 'procedural', savedAt: ISO string }. `skin` is NOT in CharacterLook (the panel has no control for it) but the engine ignores skinTone on the photo skin, so the draft carries the engine's config.skin.
- CharacterService (public API of #8005/#8110 unchanged, two additions): `clearDraft(): void` removes the key; the draft is WRITTEN after every applied change (the change() queue: setRace, setRaceMix, setRaceSize, setBodyType, setBody, setShape, setSkinTone, setHair, wear, pose), never on load, never on detach. On load(), a readable draft is applied after the default load (state$ stays 'loading' until the draft is applied; 'ready' means the restored look is on the plate and look$ shows it). A draft that fails to apply (unknown race / outfit / clip in a newer pack, parse error, wrong version) is dropped (clearDraft) and the default character stays; never 'error' for a bad draft.
- The FLUSH: RendererComponent.exportComposedSTLFile() (the project's Export STL: the platform-setup footer button -> ExportSTLAction -> the store counter -> this method; also Ctrl+E) calls characterService.clearDraft() right after downloadFile(...) - the moment the STL file is handed to the browser's download (the browser reports nothing later, so this is the "written to disk" the app can see). No visible meshes -> no download -> NO clear. Add to plate does NOT clear the draft (the user may export later); the character panel is not touched by this board.
- CharacterDraftStore (providedIn root, app/frontend/src/app/core/services/character/character-draft.store.ts): read(): CharacterDraft | null (JSON.parse in try/catch, null when the key is missing, unparsable, not an object, or version !== 1); write(draft): void (JSON.stringify; a throwing localStorage - quota, disabled storage - is swallowed: persistence is best effort, the app never breaks because of it); clear(): void. The store is the ONLY place that touches window.localStorage for the character.
HOW (service, app/frontend/src/app/core/services/character/character.service.ts): inject CharacterDraftStore (constructor param or inject()). In change(): after settle() + publishLook() add this.persist() = drafts.write({ version: 1, look: this.look.value, skin: character.config.skin, savedAt: new Date().toISOString() }). In doLoad(): after `await character.wear(this.outfit)` read the draft; when present: try { await this.applyDraft(character, draft) } catch (e) { console.warn('CharacterService: stored look dropped', e); this.drafts.clear() } - then settle(), catalog, publishLook(), 'ready' as now. applyDraft(character, draft): const l = draft.look; await character.setRace(l.race) (a typical member first, so an unknown race rejects here); await character.set({ race2: l.race2, raceMix: l.raceMix, raceSize: l.raceSize, body: { ...l.body }, shape: { ...l.shape }, skin: draft.skin, skinTone: l.skinTone, hair: l.hair, hairColor: l.hairColor }); await character.wear(l.outfit); if (l.animation) { await character.play(l.animation, 0); character.seek(l.poseTime); character.paused = true }; then this.bodyType = l.bodyType, this.outfit = l.outfit, this.animation = l.animation, this.poseTime = l.animation ? l.poseTime : 0. clearDraft(): this.drafts.clear(). detach() does NOT clear the draft (a route change is not an export). NOTE the fake engine of the spec: setRace replaces config.race, set merges body and replaces the rest - the spec asserts the calls and the look$ that results, in this order.
HOW (store): new app/frontend/src/app/core/services/character/character-draft.store.ts + spec; the model interface CharacterDraft + the key constant CHARACTER_DRAFT_KEY = 'rwclab.character.draft' in new app/frontend/src/app/core/models/character/character-draft.ts (imported by the store, the service spec and documented for the gate). jsdom (jest) has a real window.localStorage: the specs use it and call localStorage.clear() in beforeEach; the "throwing storage" spec uses jest.spyOn(Storage.prototype, 'setItem').mockImplementation(() => { throw new Error('QuotaExceededError') }) and restores it.
HOW (renderer, app/frontend/src/app/app-modules/delta/components/renderer/renderer.component.ts, ONE line): in exportComposedSTLFile() after downloadFile(stlBinary, ...) add this.characterService.clearDraft() (the component already has "private readonly characterService = inject(CharacterService)", line ~279). Renderer spec (app/frontend/src/app/app-modules/delta/components/renderer/renderer.component.spec.ts, describe 'Export STL (exportComposedSTLFile)' - the spec uses the REAL CharacterService from TestBed and spies on it, see the 'CharacterService' describe near line 630): const clear = jest.spyOn(TestBed.inject(CharacterService), 'clearDraft'); the 'two visible meshes -> one binary STL' test also expects clear toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1) AFTER download (compare mock.invocationCallOrder); 'no visible meshes -> no download' also expects clear not called.
Nothing else changes: no new control, no i18n key, no change to look$, the control names or the character panel (the lab-ui contract of 8310).
